items.name: The Lion King
items.reviewContent: This is the first show I saw on Broadway but not my first theater show! I actually saw Lion King in London in the 90s as a kid. And fun fact, Lion King was the first ever move I saw in a movie theater too. This show is amazing and has one of the best opening numbers out of all the musicals I have seen over the years.
